name: robots/pairlab__leibnizgym
title: LeibnizGym TriFinger IsaacGym environment
intro: LeibnizGym TriFinger IsaacGym environment, adapted from pairlab/leibnizgym. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset_world` and `set_seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
